Messages.Author: R. David Zopf
Messages.Body:
LSJ,
Please offer a quick clarification on Form of Mist according to the
new ruling.

Form of Mist:
New card text:
"Superior: Strike: Combat Ends. If this vampire is the acting
vampire, this
vampire gets +1 stealth (and this card counts as an action modifier)
and the
action continues as if unblocked."

RDZ's nefarious Scenario:
Vamp A bleeds, is blocked, plays sup. FoM, and is blocked again...

Since FoM "card counts as an action modifier," would a player be
prohibited from choosing to play a Form of Mist in the second combat?
Or would the FoM strike be playable with the "action continues" text
nullified? Or is there some other resolution I'm missing? (Note to
all, I like the fact that this is being limited, I just want to know
more about exactly how much is being limited...)

Regards,
R. David Zopf
guenh...@mindspring.com

Correct. Note that the vamp could play it at inferior (to Dodge), since the
inferior is not an action modifier.
